page.overview:
Who is Talbert Family?

The Talbert Family in Fazbear Frights comprises the relatives of Dr. Talbert from the Stitchwraith Stingers saga. Dr.

Talbert (full name unknown) is one of the supporting characters of the Stitchwraith Stingers series, and first appeared in the epilogue of Fazbear Frights 10: Friendly Face. He is a scientist who collects and studies the Remnant. Mrs.

Talbert (full name unknown) was the wife of Dr. Talbert and mother of Renelle Talbert. Although only mentioned, she passed away two years prior to the events of the epilogues. Renelle Talbert is the daughter of the Talbert parents.

She was kicked out of the house two years ago after her mother's death, ending up going missing. Fortunately, Jake was able to find her and bring her back to her father.
